brief:
Requestor/BU: Video & Entertainment Marketing.

Business objective: Grow video attach rate among single-product internet subscribers ahead of the fall programming season.

Audience definition: xfinityInternet = true AND xfinityTV = false.

Channel/destination: Email.

Offer: Bundle pricing on a TV tier; first 3 months at promotional rate.

Flight dates: Launch 4 weeks from approval; 6-week flight.

Success metrics: Video add-on conversion rate; incremental ARPU per converted household.

Suppressions: Existing TV subscribers.

CDP team notes: Cleanest fit for the schema as built.
